title: Profitable Growth and Market Expansion | GOP
description: GOP helps promoter-led businesses find profitable growth: market and segment prioritisation, new categories and channels, and a new-customer engine.

nodes.name: Profitable Growth and Market Expansion
nodes.description: GOP assesses where growth can come from, including existing customers, new segments, products, channels and geographies, and ranks each option by commercial attractiveness and execution feasibility. It then builds a structured engine to win new customers, including OEM and export accounts, so new business no longer depends on the promoter's network.

audience.audienceType: Promoter-led businesses, primarily INR 150-500 crore revenue, and their investors
